mechanism: MVRV compares market value with aggregate on-chain realized cost basis. A higher MVRV implies a larger aggregate unrealized-profit cushion and potentially more sell-side realization pressure; a lower MVRV implies cheaper market value relative to aggregate realized cost basis. The primary directional hypothesis is therefore contrarian: higher MVRV predicts lower subsequent BTC returns.

chronology.rule: 2024-2025 holdout outcomes are not opened unless the 2019-2023 Discovery gate passes.

predictor.transform_reason: Log transform is frozen before outcomes to reduce ratio skew; no rolling threshold or cycle-specific tuning is used.

outcome.inference: OLS with Newey-West/HAC maxlags=30 because 30-day forward returns overlap.

discovery_diagnostics.quintiles: Fixed sample quintiles of ln(MVRV) computed only inside Discovery.
discovery_diagnostics.spread: mean future 30d return in lowest MVRV quintile minus highest MVRV quintile
discovery_diagnostics.note: Quintile spread is corroborative, not used to redefine the regression.

holdout_model.coefficients: Frozen alpha/beta estimated on 2019-2023 Discovery only.
holdout_model.benchmark: constant mean 30d log return from Discovery
holdout_model.holdout_quintiles: Use Discovery quintile cutpoints; do not recompute thresholds in holdout.

promotion_boundary: SURVIVES means predictive relationship survived this holdout, not a tradable strategy and not a diamond.
Any executable strategy translation requires a new pre-freeze with costs and trading rules.
no_rescue: Do not change 30-day horizon after outcomes.
Do not switch to MVRV Z-score, FF MVRV, NUPL or reconstructed realized cap.
